title: Signal or Noise in Multi-Agent LLM-based Stock Recommendations?
central_strategy: Four specialist LLM agents (News, Fundamentals, Dynamics, Macro) feed a synthesis agent that emits a five-class monthly recommendation. On the first Friday of each month, all strong-buy stocks in fixed S&P 500/100 cohorts are held equal weight for one month; thesis/agent text embeddings are separately decomposed by normalized NNLS for attribution.

required_but_missing: The 467- and 94-stock cohort ticker lists, formation vintage, exact first-Friday timestamps, and price/return fields.
Specialist/synthesis model identities, snapshots, prompts, parameters, live request timestamps, and raw responses.
All 12,163 specialist summaries, synthesis theses, five-class recommendation labels, and strong-buy membership by date.
The text-embedding-3-small requests and 1,536-dimensional thesis/agent embedding arrays.
The fixed Monte Carlo seed/arrays, NNLS implementation/tolerances, dated IC arrays, costs, holdings, and NAV paths.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_aggregate_counts_are_not_actions: Published class counts and average 35.1/9.9 strong-buy picks do not identify which securities were selected on any date; countless incompatible portfolios share the same aggregates.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_nnls_is_not_the_signal: NNLS decomposes already-generated thesis embeddings for attribution. Without the texts/embeddings and recommendation labels, it cannot generate the strong-buy portfolio.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP supplies monthly securities and returns but not the deployed system's multimodal inputs, LLM outputs, cohort mapping, or strong-buy identities. Applying the aggregate 7.5% rate to arbitrary JKP names would fabricate decisions.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_new_record_is_not_a_release: The September 4 research record summarizes the paper and explicitly declares research-only, not-implemented status; it contains no code, recommendations, holdings, or result arrays.

closure_rule: Do not reconstruct holdings from class counts, use future returns to infer strong buys, or treat the research memo/NNLS component as the strategy. Reopen for the dated recommendation panel or attributable operational release.
